leakage_notes: Behavioural variables (fundamentalist_weight, extrapolator_weight, behavioural_response) were computed by the ABM using fuel.shift(-1) as the realised price target.  This embeds mild look-ahead in the rolling MSFE.  The Energy+AR model does NOT use behavioural features and is leakage-free.  Behavioural features are used only in Energy+Behavioural+AR and Full, where an extra lag(1) was applied at merge time as a partial mitigation.
